settings.title: How it works
settings.content: After checkout, reply to your order confirmation email with 3 to 5 clear photos of your pet. Our artists illustrate them and email your finished files within 3 to 5 days.

settings.title: What you'll receive
settings.content: High-resolution digital files; nothing physical ships. Posters arrive as a 300 DPI JPG and a print-ready PDF, art as JPG and PNG with a phone-wallpaper crop, and stickers as WhatsApp-ready 512×512 transparent PNGs with an install guide.

settings.title: Delivery & revisions
settings.content: Everything arrives by email within 3 to 5 days. No shipping, no waiting at the door. One free round of revisions is included, so we can tweak until it's just right.

settings.giveback_text: Drawn by a human artist, never AI. Files arrive by email within 3 to 5 days.
